lines.text: Jonathan loved David as himself, made a covenant with him, and gave him his robe, tunic, sword, bow, and belt.
The women sang that Saul had slain his thousands and David his tens of thousands, and Saul was furious.
While David played the harp, Saul hurled his spear at David and David eluded him twice.
Saul offered David his older daughter Merab, but she was given in marriage to Barzillai of Meholah.
Saul asked for a hundred Philistine foreskins, and David and his men killed three hundred Philistines.
